exclusion_reason: No guest loop executes, so no run can be recorded or replayed.
promotion_trigger: Promote when two replay of the recorded fixture and a replay on a second machine produce the identical state hash.
expected_failing_assertion: The report surface writes no session and no replay exists to compare.
active_gate_evidence: The report command keeps consent recording privacy-minimized and off by default.
procedure: Record the fixture run with every declared nondeterminism source pinned.
Replay twice locally and once on a second machine.
Compare the guest state hash at every declared checkpoint.
pass_criterion: All replay hash-match at every checkpoint.
No pinned source is read from the host environment.
